item.title: CVE-2026-115415 - Secret masking bypass in the environment tool in Strands Agents Tools
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-154-AWS Publication Date: 10/28/2026 12:30 PM PDT Description: We identified CVE-2026-115415, an issue where the environment tool accepted a masking parameter from the large language model (LLM) through its tool schema. A crafted prompt, delivered through content the agent is asked to process, could instruct the model to call the tool with masking turned off. The tool would then return the agent host's environment variables in cleartext, including cloud credentials and API keys, without prompting the operator for consent. item.title: CVE-2026-115413 - AWS API MCP Server OAuth token audience validation bypass
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-152-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/27/2026 11:00 AM PDT Description: The AWS API MCP Server is an open source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to interact with AWS services and resources through AWS CLI commands. It can be configured to serve the streamable-http transport with OAuth authentication, validating a bearer token against an identity provider nominated by the operator. We identified CVE-2026-115413 in versions >=1.3.0 and <1.6.0, the server validates a token's signature, issuer and expiry, but not the claim identifying the application the token was issued for. Impacted versions: >=1.3.

An incomplete list of disallowed inputs might allow an authenticated remote user to execute arbitrary code within their own isolated session environment via a crafted script. item.title: OpenSSL 4.1.0
item.description: [Infrastructure] OpenSSL Releases: OpenSSL 4.1.0 is a feature release adding significant new functionality to OpenSSL. This release incorporates the following potentially significant or incompatible changes: Added VC-WIN32-MSVC2013 and VC-WIN64A-MSVC2013 build targets to provide internal functions for bridging the gaps in C99 standard support that are present in MSVC 2013. Added optimized ML-DSA and ML-KEM NTT operations on ppc64le ; optimized ML-DSA operations on x86_64 ; AVX-512-optimized SHAKE x4 operations for ML-DSA on x86_64 ; AVX-512 and VAES optimizations for AES-CBC decryption on x86_64 .
